svg.title: Pose versus fixed-correspondence shape
svg.desc: A synthetic planar contour in millimetres and its rotated, translated copy. Equal axis limits and aspect ratios. Dashed moving curve overlays the solid reference after proper rigid alignment; size and reflections are not removed.
